title: Reexamining Racial Disparities in Automatic Speech Recognition Performance: The Role of Confounding by Provenance

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the Word Error Rate (WER) and semantic similarity of the Whisper ASR model on the Corpus of Regional African American Language (CORAAL) to analyze performance disparities on African American English (AAE).

Training character-level autoregressive language models on different geographical subsets of African American English to measure linguistic variation (perplexity) and correlating it with ASR performance differences.
